mapper.insert: insert into usage_daily (stat_date, user_id, model_code, provider_id, request_count, success_count, total_tokens, user_amount, cost_amount) values (#{statDate}, #{userId}, #{modelCode}, #{providerId}, 1, #{successCount}, #{totalTokens}, #{userAmount}, #{costAmount}) on duplicate key update request_count = request_count + 1, success_count = success_count + values(success_count), total_tokens = total_tokens + values(total_tokens), user_amount = user_amount + values(user_amount), cost_amount = cost_amount + values(cost_amount), updated_at = now()

insert into package_usage_daily (stat_date, user_id, user_package_id, request_count, success_count, total_tokens, user_amount, cost_amount) values (#{statDate}, #{userId}, #{userPackageId}, 1, #{successCount}, #{totalTokens}, #{userAmount}, #{costAmount}) on duplicate key update request_count = request_count + 1, success_count = success_count + values(success_count), total_tokens = total_tokens + values(total_tokens), user_amount = user_amount + values(user_amount), cost_amount = cost_amount + values(cost_amount), updated_at = now()
